lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge feature running along the lateral midline, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with shadow below the ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance spots localized within the basal and posterior regions of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
